title: Threat, Clock, Pressure & Escalation Authoring
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation Authoring over the MAS-01..07 foundations while preserving the MAS program boundary between prepared authoring semantics and canonical/live runtime state.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation authoring inside the MAS workspace without treating prepared authoring as live occurrence or canonical owner-state mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically author Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation material over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical/runtime authority and never treating prepared authoring as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition is authorized or required.
MAS-01 workspace/document authority through MAS-07 prepared cast planning remain foundational and are not reopened silently.

Threat, Clock, Pressure and Escalation structures are prepared authoring semantics only; actual occurrence, progress, triggering, Action/Event emission and canonical mutation remain with the applicable runtime/owner domains resolved from targeted source seams.
Authored or linked threat/clock/pressure/escalation material never proves that a threat manifested, a clock advanced, pressure changed or escalation occurred.
MAS-09 retains Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window & Timed Event Planning scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-09+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: On the authorized application branch, load only MAS-07 plus targeted threat/clock/pressure/escalation and runtime-owner seams, establish causal MAS-08 RED, then implement the minimum deterministic prepared-authoring contract without pulling MAS-09 timed-event planning forward.
